title: The eye sign, from inside
logline: The eye sign from inside the shop window, backward, and through it the street: the seawall, the crow, a man in plaid from behind with an old dog, looking in. The page is on the other side of the town's other story, looking out.

panels.composition: From inside a shop: a hand-painted eye sign in the window seen from its back, and through the glass a main street with a seawall, a crow, and a man in plaid from behind with an old three-legged dog looking in.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, from inside a shop, a hand-painted eye sign seen from its back in the window and through the glass a street with a seawall and a crow and a man in plaid flannel seen from behind with an old three-legged dog looking in, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From the other side, looking out.
